headline: This law renames the Jimmy Carter National Historic Site in Georgia as the Jimmy Carter National Historical Park.
what_it_does: The law changes the official name and designation of the Jimmy Carter National Historic Site in Georgia. After it takes effect, the site is called the Jimmy Carter National Historical Park. The official summary does not describe any other changes to the site.
when_it_takes_effect: The law was enacted on January 13, 2021, and the redesignation took effect on that date.
